output.reason: [ev-8ceba924ad20] and [ev-632a3911583a] say the step is needed only when the key-prefix flag or its YAML setting is set to "a value other than `index/`". The proposed `cli-flag ... set` leaves is too broad: it also flags environments that set the prefix to `index/` explicitly. Each flag leaf should require that the flag is set and does not equal `index/`. The YAML setting and whether existing period configs already carry the matching `path_prefix` cannot be seen from flags, so an undecidable operand stays.

correction.statement: Exposed: environments where -boltdb.shipper.shared-store.key-prefix or -tsdb.shipper.shared-store.key-prefix (or the matching YAML setting) is set to a value other than `index/`. Existing boltdb-shipper or tsdb period configs then need `path_prefix` set to that earlier value.

of.needed: whether the YAML shared_store_key_prefix setting for the boltdb-shipper or tsdb shipper is set to a value other than index/, and whether existing period configs using that index lack a matching path_prefix
